sentences.text: No: for a Tier 3 UCB, a floating-rate business loan to an MSE sanctioned on or after 1 January 2026 with sanctioned amount/limit up to ₹50 lakh must not have any pre-payment charges levied.
The older RBI directions on foreclosure or pre-payment penalties are no longer in force on 2026-11-23, and the 2025 UCB directions are the applicable in-force rule for this case.
